<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
Cuz it wakes you the fuck up!

By "nap," you mean you wanna have me for
dessert after you're done stuffin' your face!

Puh-lease! You really think a loser like you
could handle a prime piece of ass like me!?

Stick to jerk-off fantasies, kiddo!
At least those are free!

Fuck that! It's too risky! What if it gives me
a heart attack and I—oh I dunno—DIE!?!?

All advancements in technology and science
would be delayed by at least two centuries!
<CLT=cltMIND>That might be taking it a bit far...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
